intro: This zone covers the northern end of Aizawl, from the Durtlang hilltop, the highest point in the city, down through Chaltlang, Bawngkawn and Ramhlun, with Zemabawk and its neighbours alongside. Durtlang and Chaltlang were once separate villages that the city absorbed by the early 1960s, and each name now stands for a cluster: Durtlang North and Leitan, Selesih and Muanna Veng; Bawngkawn South and West; Ramhlun North, Venglai, Vengthar and South; Zemabawk's four parts with Falkland and Thuampui. Families here can find a tutor within the same chain of localities instead of looking across town.

Homes follow the usual Aizawl pattern of multi-storey buildings on steep slopes, with some flats above the road and others below it, so the entrance and floor matter as much as the locality name. Zemabawk is the exception in mix: industrial land at Zuangtui and state rental blocks at Falkland sit near ordinary houses, and the larger blocks may note visitors. Tutors move about by two-wheeler or car, because road travel is the only way across the city. The roads from this end into the centre are busy at office hours, and heavy rain from April to October slows the climb to Durtlang.

The Mizoram Board of School Education lists its office at Chaltlang, and the academic wing of the state school directorate has worked from there since it was set up, so HSLC and HSSLC paperwork is close at hand for families in this zone. For the teaching itself, NXTutors starts with tutors who live in these localities, then those who travel to the zone, then the rest of Aizawl, then online. A request returns two or three matched tutors, each fee is on the profile before a free first demo, and changing tutor later costs nothing.
faqs: Which localities belong to the Durtlang, Chaltlang & Bawngkawn zone?

Five area pages cover it: Durtlang, Chaltlang, Bawngkawn, Ramhlun and Zemabawk. Each one is a cluster rather than a single street, taking in places such as Selesih, Chaltlang Lily Veng, Bawngkawn West, Ramhlun Vengthar, Falkland and Thuampui, so pick the page for your cluster and name the exact locality in the request.
Can one tutor teach students in Durtlang and in Zemabawk?

Yes, if they live in between. Bawngkawn sits on the same stretch of hills as Durtlang and is a near neighbour of Zemabawk, so a tutor based there can cover both. Tutors on the far side of the centre are less practical for weekly visits to this northern end.
Why do evening slots need care in this northern zone?

Because most tutors coming from elsewhere use the roads into the centre, which are busy at office hours, and the climb to Durtlang is slower in heavy rain between April and October. A fixed time after the evening rush, or a tutor who lives in the zone, keeps lessons on schedule.
How does NXTutors decide which tutors to show for a home in this zone?

By distance. NXTutors lists tutors living in your own locality first, then the rest of the zone, then those elsewhere in Aizawl, and finally online tutors. You get two or three matches with their fees visible, try the one you prefer at a free first demo, and can switch later at no cost.

intro: The Chanmari, Zarkawt & Dawrpui zone is the centre of Aizawl. Chanmari shares a municipal ward with Electric Veng and Zarkawt, and Chanmari West forms its own ward with Edenthar and Hunthar. Zarkawt takes in McDonald Hill, where the Directorate of School Education has its offices, and it was here, in February 1944, that the first high school in the Mizo hills opened. Dawrpui Veng holds Bara Bazar, the city's main shopping centre, and shares a ward with Saron Veng, Chhinga Veng and Tuithang Veng. The district's central zone also counts Aizawl Venglai and Chite among these localities.

Being central, these three localities mix offices, shops and homes, with families in multi-storey buildings that rise above and drop below the main roads. That makes the zone easy to reach from almost every side, but hard to time: central roads stay busy through the day, Bara Bazar draws crowds in shopping hours, and the morning and evening office rush affects every route. A two-wheeler is far easier to park than a car, so most tutors use one and walk the last part. Choose a start time away from the rush and give a precise landmark, the building name and the floor.

With tutors able to come in from Ramhlun, Khatla, Tuikual and the northern localities, a central family usually has a wider choice than one on the edge of the city. NXTutors still begins with tutors who live in Chanmari, Zarkawt or Dawrpui, then those who travel to the zone, then the rest of Aizawl, then online for specialist Class 11 and 12 subjects. You compare two or three matched tutors, see each fee before the free first demo, and can switch later without paying anything. Board-year students on the HSLC or HSSLC can ask for that experience in the request.
faqs: Which area pages make up the Chanmari, Zarkawt & Dawrpui zone?

Three: Chanmari, Zarkawt and Dawrpui. Between them they cover the centre of Aizawl, including Electric Veng, Chanmari West, McDonald Hill, Saron Veng and Chhinga Veng. If you live in Dawrpui Vengthar, note that it is a separate locality in another ward and appears with the Tuikual and Vaivakawn group.
What time of day suits home tuition in central Aizawl?

A slot that avoids both the office rush and the busiest shopping hours. Roads around Bara Bazar in Dawrpui are crowded for much of the day, and Zarkawt's government offices fill nearby roads at opening and closing. A later evening start is usually the easiest to keep each week.
Is the centre a good place to find a tutor for a senior subject?

Often, because tutors from many localities can reach it. Tutors living in Ramhlun, Khatla or Tuikual can all come to Chanmari, Zarkawt or Dawrpui, which widens the choice for Class 11 and 12 subjects. When no one nearby teaches a subject, an online tutor fills the gap.
How will a central Aizawl family know a tutor's fee in advance?

It is on every matched tutor's profile, and tutors set their own rates. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.

intro: This zone runs out from the edge of central Aizawl to the outskirts. Tuikual North and Tuikual South form a ward with Dinthar; Vaivakawn shares one with Dawrpui Vengthar and Kanan Veng; and Luangmual heads a ward of outer localities with Chawlhhmun, Tanhril, Sakawrtuichhun, Rangvamual and Phunchawng. The district's zonal list joins Tuikual and Vaivakawn with Hunthar and Edenthar, and puts Luangmual with Kanaan, Chawnpui, Zotlang and Zonuam. Tanhril, on the outskirts, is where a large institutional campus sits on forested hillside. Aizawl's new rail link, ending at Sairang station, opened in September 2025, but daily trips around the city remain by road.

Housing is multi-storey buildings on steep slopes, and in this zone deep valleys separate one locality from the next. A tutor on the same side of the valley may arrive sooner than one who looks closer on a map, so ask any tutor to confirm the route before the demo. Vaivakawn is where the central group of localities meets the Luangmual group, which makes it the easiest point to reach from both. Tanhril's campus housing may set its own visitor rules, while ordinary houses let a tutor come straight to the door. Allow extra time in heavy rain on the hill roads.

Families at the outer end, in Luangmual or Tanhril, gain most from a tutor who lives nearby, because a tutor coming from the centre has a longer ride. NXTutors builds every shortlist that way: tutors in your own locality, then those elsewhere in the zone or who travel to it, then the rest of Aizawl, then online for specialist subjects. Two or three matched tutors arrive with each request, every fee shows on the profile before the free first demo, and switching later is free. A home tutor for core subjects and an online one for a specialist subject is a workable mix here.
faqs: Which localities are covered by the Tuikual, Vaivakawn & Luangmual zone?

Four area pages: Tuikual, Vaivakawn, Luangmual and Tanhril. Together they include Dinthar, Dawrpui Vengthar, Kanan Veng, Hunthar, Edenthar, Chawnpui, Zonuam, Chawlhhmun, Rangvamual and Phunchawng, running from the edge of the centre out to the outskirts of Aizawl. Choose the page nearest your home and name your own locality in the request.
Why should we check the tutor's route in this zone?

Because deep valleys separate the localities, so the straight-line distance on a map can mislead. A tutor in Dinthar or Vaivakawn may reach a Tuikual home more easily than one who looks closer across a valley. Asking the tutor to confirm the road route before the demo avoids a late first class.
Is a tutor from the city centre practical for Luangmual or Tanhril?

Sometimes, but a nearby tutor is usually easier. These localities are at the outer end of the zone, so a tutor from the centre faces a longer ride, especially in heavy rain. Tutors from Chawnpui, Zonuam or Vaivakawn are closer, and online classes cover specialist subjects.
What happens after a family in this zone sends a request?

NXTutors shortlists two or three tutors, looking first in your locality, then across the zone, then the wider city, then online. Each profile shows the tutor's fee, so you can compare before booking, and the first class with your choice is a free demo. Changing tutor later costs nothing.

intro: Khatla, Mission Veng & Kulikawn covers a set of older residential clusters of Aizawl through four area pages. Khatla forms a ward with Khatla South and Mission Venglang, and Khatla East joins Bungkawn, Maubawk, Lawipu and Nursery Veng in the next ward. Mission Veng and Mission Vengthlang sit with Salem Veng, Dam Veng, Venghnuai, Tuikhuahtlang and Model Veng. Bethlehem Veng and Bethlehem Vengthlang share a ward with College Veng, beside the Republic localities, and Bethlehem Vengthlang is where a national research centre for bamboo and rattan opened in 2004. Kulikawn's ward takes in Tlangnuam, Saikhamakawn, Melthum and Hlimen.

Most families here live in multi-storey buildings set into the slopes, so tutors usually park a two-wheeler at the road and take steps up or down to the flat. Localities are divided by valleys, which is why the practical tutor for Kulikawn is often someone in Tlangnuam or Thakthing, and for Khatla someone in Bungkawn, Maubawk or Lawipu. Roads towards the centre are busiest at office hours, and on match days the roads around Mualpui in Salem Veng fill up, so avoid those times for lessons. Allow extra time in heavy rain, and share the building name, floor and a landmark.

Because the zone splits naturally into clusters, the simplest arrangement is a tutor from your own cluster for weekly visits. NXTutors searches in that order: your locality first, then the rest of the zone, then those elsewhere in Aizawl who travel here, then online tutors for subjects with no one nearby. You see two or three matched tutors with their fees before the free first demo, and can switch later at no cost. Students in Class 10 or Class 12 can ask for HSLC or HSSLC experience, and CBSE students for that syllabus, when they send the request.
faqs: Which area pages fall in the Khatla, Mission Veng & Kulikawn zone?

Four: Khatla, Mission Veng and Mission Vengthlang, Bethlehem and Bethlehem Vengthlang, and Kulikawn. They take in nearby places such as Bungkawn, Maubawk, Salem Veng, Venghnuai, College Veng, Republic Veng, Tlangnuam and Saikhamakawn, so choose the page for your cluster and name your exact locality when you ask for a tutor.
Which days are awkward for tutor visits near Salem Veng?

Match days, when the roads around Mualpui in Salem Veng get crowded. Families in Mission Veng and the neighbouring localities should keep lessons away from those hours, and weekday office rush hours towards the centre are worth avoiding too. A tutor living in the same cluster is least affected.
Can a tutor in Khatla also teach in Bethlehem or Kulikawn?

Possibly, but valleys separate the clusters, so check the route first. A tutor in Khatla or Bungkawn is most practical for homes around Khatla, while Bethlehem families do better with someone from Republic or Venghlui, and Kulikawn families with someone from Tlangnuam or Thakthing who can keep a weekly slot.
Does a family in Khatla, Mission Veng or Kulikawn pay for the demo class?

No, the first class with any tutor NXTutors matches is a free demo. Before it, you see the fee on each of your two or three matched tutors' profiles, starting with those nearest your home. If the tutor later stops suiting your child, you can switch without paying anything.
